== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Sai'torr Kal Fas (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Sai'torr Kal Fas]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100709 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100709], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100709-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d8d6ffccb4ed41ef7592850026649379f10d08f02a16d753bf967ba5cd511823</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
